item.title: 1 Burned in Vacant North Bellport House Fire
item.description: On January 20, 2026, at approximately 0700, the Bellport Fire Department, along with mutual aid from South Country Ambulance, Hagerman, North Patchogue and Brookhaven, responded to a structure fire in a vacant home on Montauk Highway in North Bellport. item.title: Resident Escapes Hempstead Blaze
item.description: The Hempstead Fire Department battled a working house fire on Warner Avenue on the afternoon of February 8, 2026. Firefighters arrived to find the rear of the home engulfed in flames. An elderly resident was able to escape to safety before units arrived. – Fire News photos by FirstOnScenePhotos.com

item.title: Rope Rescue Training Complete
item.description: Our firefighters completed Rope Rescue Training on February 4th, to ensure we are ready to save the citizens of Cobb in any scenario. When disaster strikes, we are prepared to respond. -Courtesy of Cobb County Fire & Emergency Services
